mapper.insert: MERGE INTO country c USING (SELECT #{isoCode} AS iso_code FROM dual) s ON (c.iso_code = s.iso_code) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET country_name = #{countryName}, country_en_name = #{countryEnName}, continent = #{continent}, img = #{img}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, currency = #{currency}, distance = #{distance} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (country_name, country_en_name, iso_code, continent, img, latitude, longitude, currency, distance) VALUES (#{countryName}, #{countryEnName}, #{isoCode}, #{continent}, #{img}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{currency}, #{distance})
mapper.update: UPDATE country SET country_name = #{countryName}, country_en_name = #{countryEnName}, iso_code = #{isoCode}, continent = #{continent}, img = #{img}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, currency = #{currency}, distance = #{distance} WHERE country_id = #{countryId}
